svg.text: ME/CFS symptom mapping – full question tree and granules

Each card = one question. Coloured chip = leaf (granule [asked facet]). Dashed chip = redirect into another section (same leaf as there). Pale chip = measured, not rated (no instrument item). After any leaf the app asks: “Is a high value good or bad for you?”
